description: This file defines functions and data structures for handling PyTree flattening and registration within the PyTorch FX framework, including support for custom node types and return types.

classes.name: PyTree
classes.description: Represents a nested data structure used in PyTorch for automatic differentiation and serialization.

classes.name: TreeSpec
classes.description: Specifies the structure of a PyTree, used for validation and flattening.

methods.name: register_pytree_flatten_spec
methods.description: Registers a custom flattening function for a specific node type.

methods.name: _deregister_pytree_flatten_spec
methods.description: Removes a previously registered flattening function for a node type.

methods.name: tree_flatten_spec
methods.description: Recursively flattens a PyTree according to a given TreeSpec, using custom node flattening functions if available.
